title: JP market: Updated APIs for Products, Orders, Logistics, and Customer service
breadcrumb: JP market: Updated APIs for Products, Orders, Logistics, and Customer service
label: TIKTOK SHOP · CHANGELOG
subtitle: Updated 2025-05-28
html:
Summary

As of today, developers can start using TikTok Shop APIs to build apps for the Japan market. The APIs and workflows are generally consistent with other regions/markets, but there are a few JP-specific updates worth calling out. Note: Before building order management modules, developers should familiarize themselves with our Orders API overview and our Fulfillment API overview.

Affected markets and versions

This change applies to the following market(s):

  • Japan (JP)

This change applies to the following API version(s):

  • 202309 (and later)

API changes

Product APIs

Endpoint(s) Change(s)
* Create Product
* Edit Product
* Partial Edit Product
* Check Product Listing
* Diagnose and Optimize Product
* Recommend Category		 * Each product can contain up to 300 SKUs
* The product price range should be within [1, 500,000] JPY
* The characters of the product title should be within [1,255]
* Use GRAM as the package weight unit for product listing
* Publish Global Product
* Edit Global Product
* Edit Product
* Partial Edit Product
* Update Price
* Get Global Product		 Added mandatory parameter sale_price, indicating the SKU's local selling price displayed on the product page before any discounts, inclusive of taxes. The sale_price parameter is only applicable to cross-border (GS-POP) sellers, and is optional in other markets.
* Get Categories
* Get Category Rules
* Get Attributes
* Update Price
* Search Size Chart
* Search Products		 Added parameter values related to locale ja-JP, currency JPY, and regions JP have been added.
* Get Global Categories
* Get Global Category Rules
* Get Global Attributes		 Added parameter values related to locale ja-JP and region JP.

Get Order Detail, Get Order List

Two response parameters have been added under recipient_address:

  • first_name_local_script: first name in katakana
  • last_name_local_script: last name in katakana

Manage Shipments

Four response parameters have been added:

  • first_name: first name in kanji
  • last_name: last name in kanji
  • first_name_local_script: first name in katakana
  • last_name_local_script: last name in katakana

Customer service APIs

All customer service API endpoints have been updated to support sending and receiving messages in Japanese.

Fulfillment APIs

Local sellers

By default, local sellers in the Japan market should follow the seller shipping (3PL) workflow (see the Fulfillment API overview for more details). Sellers must use the following integrated carriers for shipping:

  • Yamato
  • Sagawa Express
  • Japan Post
  • Seino Transportation
  • Seino Super Express

For local sellers, the seller shipping workflow should generally follow these steps:

  1. The seller ships the package and obtains the shipment tracking number from the shipping carrier.
  2. Use the Get Shipping Providers endpoint to retrieve the shipping service provider IDs supported by TikTok Shop.
  3. Use the Mark Package as Shipped endpoint to upload the tracking number and shipping provider ID.

China cross-border (GS-POP) sellers

China cross-border sellers should use the following fulfillment workflows:

Shipping type Endpoint(s)
Oversea warehouse 1. The seller ships the package and obtains the shipment tracking number from the shipping carrier.
2. Use the Get Shipping Providers endpoint to retrieve the shipping service provider IDs supported by TikTok Shop.
3. Use the Mark Package as Shipped endpoint to upload the tracking number and shipping provider ID.
Direct shipping 1. The seller schedules the package handover time and method with the shipping provider.
2. Use the Ship Package endpoint to schedule the package handover time and method.
3. Use the Get Package Shipping Document endpoint to get the shipping label.
